title: Bang-bang protocol for nondispersive qubit readout
summary: Fast, precise, and quantum-non-demolition (QND) readout of superconducting qubits is a fundamental component of high-fidelity quantum sensing and computation. Conventional approaches typically operate in the dispersive regime, where the qubit-resonator coupling $g$ is weak compared to the detuning $Δ$. While exhibiting good QND properties, the readout rate is limited to $\sim g^2\sqrt{N}/Δ\ll g$, where $N$ is the number of photons in the resonator.
